subject: Provisioning cohort stipend credits — qualification & MAP
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam@foundrylabs.io>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry — cohort stipend credits for Fall '26 program

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our side. We’re running a 12-week Fall cohort (starts Oct 4) and are evaluating partners for cloud/infra credits to use as cohort stipends (teams will use for pilot PoCs). Our program budget is modest; we’d love to understand Redwood’s accelerator credit program and whether Foundry Labs could qualify for a cohort stipend allocation.

Key details:
- Cohort size: ~18 teams (see attached roster)
- Intended usage: inference for prototype features, up to ~100k tokens/week aggregate at start
- Timeline: Oct–Dec 2026

Primary questions:
1) What are Redwood’s qualification criteria for cohort stipend credits?
2) Is it possible to provision a conditional/trial credit pool that ramps with milestones?
3) Any paperwork or PO/process we should plan for?

I’ve attached the roster and a brief program syllabus. If useful, can jump on a short call later this week.

Thanks,
Liam Chen
Program Lead — Foundry Labs
liam@foundrylabs.io

Attachment stubs: Foundry-Cohort-Roster.csv, Syllabus-Fall26.pdf

From: camila_reyes@redwoodai.com <camila_reyes@redwoodai.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry — cohort stipend credits for Fall '26 program

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the roster. Short answer: yes, we commonly support cohort stipend allocations via a conditional credit pool tied to a Mutual Action Plan (MAP). I’ve outlined a pragmatic approach below and attached a short qualification checklist you can use to confirm fit.

Proposed approach (high level):
- Provisional credit pool: $5,000 USD equivalent in usage credits to start (refundable-to-credit if unused).
- Ramp triggers: additional $5k after 2 successful team pilots (validated by minimal evaluation prompts and an acceptance checklist).
- Timebox: credits active Oct 4 — Dec 31, 2026.

What we need from Foundry to fast-track:
1) Completed qualification checklist (attached).
2) Point of contact for billing/procurement or signed PO if you prefer a net-30 invoice.
3) A short MAP doc (1 page) listing milestones, point owners, and acceptance criteria — I’ve attached a draft (Draft-MAP-Foundry-v1.docx) you can edit.

Next steps: if that sounds acceptable, please fill the checklist and we’ll provision the provisional pool within 48 hours of receipt. I can loop legal only at the point you opt for a PO/invoice — otherwise we can issue credits via the hosted account.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Partner Sales — Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwoodai.com

Attachment stubs: Program-Qualification-Checklist.pdf, Draft-MAP-Foundry-v1.docx

Adding a quick note on process so procurement has clarity:
- We can provision credits to a single Foundry-managed account and create sub-keys for teams; that’s the simplest for reporting and cost visibility.
- If Foundry needs an invoice/PO (net 30), legal will review the standard credit agreement — timeline typically 3–5 business days for minor changes.
- For the ramp we propose: initial $5k then $5k on 2 validated pilots (validation = short video + 3 eval prompts OR acceptance test in checklist).

If Foundry prefers, we can also do an initial smaller tranche ($2k) to start and scale faster. Camila — happy for you to confirm the credit amount and trigger cadence.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
ben_carter@redwoodai.com

Liam — great, all sounds aligned. Finalizing below so we can move quickly: 

Decision/plan:
- Provision: $5,000 USD credits to Foundry-managed account upon receipt of completed qualification checklist.
- Ramp: +$5,000 USD after 2 validated team pilots. Validation accepted = video demo (<=10 min) + 3 eval prompts OR completed acceptance items in the checklist.
- Sub-accounts: we will provision sub-keys for each team and provide a simple reporting dashboard.
- Contracting: if you want an invoice/PO we’ll follow the standard credit agreement; otherwise we’ll add credits directly to the hosted account.

Action items:
- Liam: share completed Program-Qualification-Checklist.pdf and confirm if you want invoice/PO (reply here).
- Foundry: update the MAP (Draft-MAP-Foundry-v1.docx) with milestone owners and target dates; please return by Tue, Sep 21.
- Camila/Ben: we will provision credits within 48 hours of receiving the completed checklist and POC for the account.
